'''ModelingToolkit.jl: Symbolic-Numeric Acausal DAE Optimization'''
[[Category:Principia Machina]] [[Category:Tools]]

== Overview & Architectural Fit ==
'''ModelingToolkit.jl''' (MTK) is a symbolic-numeric composable modeling framework written in Julia. It acts as an advanced, next-generation acausal compiler that directly addresses the symbolic limitations of traditional Modelica.

== Mathematical Evaluation for TPM & SVD ==
* '''Euler-Lagrange Derivation & DAE Compilation (9.5/10):''' MTK accepts symbolic Lagrangian actions <math>L(q, \dot{q}, t)</math> and natively computes symbolic partial derivatives (<math>\frac{\partial L}{\partial \dot{q}}</math>, <math>\frac{\partial L}{\partial q}</math>) to generate full Euler-Lagrange DAEs automatically before performing Pantelides index reduction.
* '''Structural Simplification:''' Automatically eliminates redundant algebraic constraints and simplifies complex multi-body systems prior to numerical code generation.
* '''Composable Scientific Machine Learning (SciML):''' Integrates natively with neural ODEs and parameter estimation pipelines.
